summary: Official HM Land Registry INSPIRE publication and Hull City Council public My Hull viewer were evidenced. Hull is listed for local-authority GML download, but the direct download was challenge-gated and no parcel geometry or native identity was retrieved. The local viewer exposed public Astun/iShare configuration but no bounded parcel response. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and native/local-language (English) discovery queries are recorded in city-6053-hull.json with actual URLs. The local-language route used English because Hull is in England and English is the relevant local/statutory service language.
requestOutcomes: Hull My Hull GET returned 200; current HTML/loader configuration was inspected. getdata.aspx returned a missing-RequestType error, and a bounded MapSource probe returned MapSource not found. HM Land Registry documentation and indexed download page were inspected; direct download access returned a Cloudflare challenge. HMLR API documentation states account/licence/API-key requirements; no credentialed request was attempted.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [53.7628896052307, -0.354103477578705] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no exact-point hit or miss inference was made.
HMLR INSPIRE polygons are indicative registered freehold extents, not definitive ownership boundaries or a complete cadastral substitute.
Hull My Hull themes are local information/property/asset mapping; no legal parcel-layer completeness was established.
No current Hull GML bytes, feature schema, feature CRS or native parcel identity was retrieved.
Cloudflare challenge, missing map-source route and absent anonymous geometry are access/verification limits, not evidence of citywide absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
